title: Junger Laubbaum C
description: Junger schlanker Laubbaum mit leicht gebogenem Leittrieb und kleinem Wurzelanlauf. Ab etwa zwei Metern verzweigte Seitenäste tragen lockere Blattspreiten; sichtbare Feinzweige und Lichtlücken prägen die junge Krone.

review.notes: Round 1. Good: a 7 m young tree with an airy crown, leaves on visible twigs, sky gaps. Defects: (1) the trunk runs as one straight pole to the top and pokes out of the crown as a bare stick (sheet tiles 2 and 5, closeup_upper); end the leader inside the foliage or fork it. (2) The silhouette is a narrow pole with a symmetric oval of leaves; give it a lean and asymmetric branches. (3) The bark is a smooth dark tube without tree_bark furrows; the root flare is minimal and sharp. (4) The foliage is dark blue-green, not olive; the sunlit leaves are pale grey-green rather than warm.
